name: Liberty
gaps: Parcels are ParcelsService TaxParcel (official Liberty County GA ArcGIS Server) (https://gis.libertycountyga.gov/arcgis/rest/services/ParcelsService/FeatureServer/15). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Household income stays the ACS B19013_001E tract join. GDOT AADT is not copied onto the parcel.
Source query returned 2274 rows; 2269 distinct parcel ids stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the geometry check.
Pass 2 tax is HTML-only, sale is HTML-only, and owner is REST. HTML-only values were not scraped.
Pass 2 tax is HTML-only. Assessed value and tax bills were not copied off qPublic.
Pass 2 sale date and price are HTML-only and were not copied.
Property-appraiser links use each parcel id in the pass-2 template and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
